claim: The Villeroy & Boch Erlebniszentrum at the Alte Abtei in Mettlach houses the Keravision exhibition combining over 260 years of ceramic and corporate history inside a former Benedictine abbey.
quote: Behind the Baroque facade, visitors can experience more than 260 years of ceramic and corporate history. The exhibition "Keravision", a ceramics museums and a museum's café in the style of 1892 tell the success story of a family dynasty.

claim: The Villeroy & Boch Factory Outlet in Mettlach sells porcelain, crystal and cutlery at discounts of up to 30% off retail, with weekday hours of 9:30-19:00 and Sunday afternoons 14:00-18:00.
quote: Monday-Wednesday: 9:30 am to 7 pm, Thursday: 9:30 am to 7 pm, Friday: 9:30 am to 7 pm, Saturday: 9:30 am to 6 pm, Sunday: 2 to 6 pm ... You can save up to 30 percent compared to regular retail prices at this outlet.

claim: Mettlach lies about 19 km / 21 minutes' drive from Perl, well inside the 30 km radius.
quote: The distance from Perl to Mettlach is 16.1 kilometers by straight line. By car, the route to Mettlach is 19.4 km long, and the drive takes 21 minutes.

claim: Schloss Saareck in Mettlach has served as Villeroy & Boch's guesthouse since 1954 and offers 22 themed rooms inspired by V&B tableware collections like Old Luxembourg and Amazonia.
quote: The historic building, which once served as a family residence for the von Boch family, has been a Villeroy&Boch AG guest house since 1954 ... Guests are welcome to stay overnight in one of the 22 guest rooms, each of which has been furnished with great attention to detail ... Each is inspired by a tableware collection of Villeroy & Boch like the legendary "Old Luxembourg" or "Amazonia".

claim: Saarburg's signature waterfall sees the Leukbach drop about 20 metres straight through the middle of the medieval old town after city rulers diverted the stream through the town layout in the 11th-12th century.
quote: The impressive waterfall cascades 20 meters down between narrow rows of houses in the middle of Saarburg's city center ... The waterfall is due to an urban planning masterpiece from the 11th or 12th century. The city rulers of that time managed to redirect the Leukbach right through the medieval town layout.

claim: Burg Saarburg is a freely accessible hilltop castle ruin first mentioned in 964 AD; climbing over 100 steps up the keep yields a panoramic view of the Saar valley, and there is a restaurant in the bailey.
quote: What remains today is mainly the round keep, closely protected by a shield wall. The ascent of over 100 steps via the narrow spiral staircase is rewarded with a magnificent panoramic view of the Saar valley ... Saarburg Castle was built by Siegfried, Count of the Ardennes ... first mentioned in 964 A.D.

claim: Mondorf Domaine Thermal in Luxembourg is a 45-hectare thermal park whose spa is fed by a strongly mineralised spring flowing at 36 °C, combining baths, saunas, fitness pavilion and a 4-star superior hotel.
quote: Nestled in a 45-hectare park, the thermal resort combines spa, wellness, fitness, hotels, restaurants, and event venues ... spa installations fed by a strongly mineralised water source flowing at 36°C

claim: Within Schloss Berg itself, Victor's Residenz-Hotel runs two casual sister restaurants — Bacchus (upscale Italian/Mediterranean) and Victor's Landgasthaus Die Scheune — alongside Christian Bau's three-star Fine Dining room.
quote: In the Bacchus restaurant, named after the Roman god of wine, you will experience a culinary journey of pleasure right through upscale Italian cuisine with fine fish and meat variations, light pasta dishes and fantastically sweet desserts.

claim: Hotel-Restaurant Hammes in the village of Perl is a 3-star family-run hotel restaurant in a quiet side street, serving German and international dishes with a strong local wine list, and convenient for cyclists and Moselle visitors.
quote: The hotel is surrounded by romantic cycling and hiking paths, picturesquely situated vineyards, and boundless garden pleasures ... The restaurant focuses on fresh, diverse and natural ingredients to turn eating into an exceptional experience.

claim: Restaurant Niedmühle in Rehlingen-Siersburg sits in the official Michelin Guide for Saarland; it is roughly 30 km from Perl, set directly on the Nied river with a winter garden and terrace.

The European Museum Schengen reopened in June 2025 with a free, multilingual permanent exhibition on the 1985 Schengen Agreement; the original signing ship MS Princesse Marie-Astrid is moored a short walk away and is open to visitors.
quote: The Schengen Museum reopened in June 2025 ... The modern permanent exhibition offers an engaging and multilingual experience, presenting the history and significance of the Schengen Agreement ... The historic ship "Prinzessin Marie-Astrid Europa", where the Schengen Agreement was signed in 1985, is anchored just a short walk from the museum and open to visitors.

claim: The Deutsches Zeitungsmuseum in Wadgassen lies about 47 km / 26 minutes' drive from Perl, putting it just outside the 30 km radius for this trip.
quote: The distance over roads between Wadgassen and Perl (Mosel) is 29 miles, and it takes approximately 26 minutes to drive.
